title: QC Pipeline Parameters
description: Parameter schema for the QC pipeline

gff_csv.description: Path to a CSV file with at least sample and gff3 columns

ensembl_genes_repo.description: Path to a local ensembl-genes checkout

pairwise_csv.description: Path to a CSV file with sample, gff_a, and gff_b columns for pairwise annotation comparison

pairwise_cache_dir.description: Directory used to cache URL inputs for pairwise annotation comparison

pairwise_ensg_lookup.description: Optional lookup TSV passed to the legacy gene-presence parser

pairwise_contig_normalization.description: Contig normalization mode passed to the legacy gene-pairing script

pairwise_multi_mapping_min_overlap.description: Minimum overlap fraction for multi-mapping summaries

run_pairwise_annotation_comparison.description: Enable the pairwise annotation comparison branch

run_pairwise_transcript_concordance.description: Enable transcript concordance metrics for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_coding_integrity.description: Enable coding integrity metrics for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_gene_presence.description: Enable gene presence metrics for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_multi_mapping.description: Enable multi-mapping summaries for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_gff_feature_metrics.description: Enable GFF feature-count metrics for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_transcript_counts.description: Enable transcript-per-gene count metrics for pairwise annotation comparison

run_pairwise_gffcompare.description: Enable optional bidirectional gffcompare transcript comparison

tracedir.description: Directory for Nextflow execution reports and trace files
